Lemma 1 (sys^2=1/y): recomputed |m+n tau|^2=m^2+2mnx+n^2(x^2+y^2)>=m^2-|mn|+n^2 using |x|<=1/2 and x^2+y^2>=1; a=|m|,b=|n| gives >=1 with equality at (1,0); scaling by y^{-1/2} gives sys^2=1/y. Correct. Lemma 2 (d_hyp<=d_c): projection H->M distance-nonincreasing, tau_h^+=tau_h^-+1 so both project to hex class; min_+/-formula gives u=1/2-|x| numerator. Reduction to d_max(y): for fixed y delta fixed, d_c monotone in u; for y>=1 all u in [0,1/2] feasible with max at x=0; for y_h<=y<1 feasibility forces |x|>=sqrt(1-y^2) so max at arc |x|=sqrt(1-y^2). N(y), t_max, d_max definitions correct. Universal estimate d^2<=2t from cosh power series truncation (all terms positive) valid. Key identity sqrt3*y*delta=2y-sqrt3 and sqrt3*y*t_max=N(y) verified via 2*y_h=sqrt3. Case 1<=y<=8/5: g(1)=0 verified exactly in Q(sqrt3) ((1-y_h)^2=7/4-sqrt3); g'=2(1+y_h-y)>=2(y_h-3/5)>0 via y_h>0.866 from 1732^2<3, so g>=0. Case y_h<=y<=1: N=2-w-sqrt3*y verified (5/4-w-y^2+y^2-sqrt3*y+3/4); need w>=(2+sqrt3)(1-y), both sides >=0 so squaring equivalent to (1-y)(1+y)>=(7+4sqrt3)(1-y)^2; for y<1 divide to y(8+4sqrt3)>=6+4sqrt3, threshold (3+2sqrt3)/(4+2sqrt3)=sqrt3/2=y_h verified using (sqrt3)^2=3 only. Holds. Cap inactivity: delta<=delta(8/5) by monotonicity; 2/sqrt3<=7/6 iff 12<=7sqrt3 iff 144<=147 true; so delta(8/5)<=13/24; cosh1-1>=1/2+1/24+1/720=391/720>=390/720=13/24 via positive-term truncation, so t_max<=cosh1-1 => d_max<=1. originality.rationale: Substantive comparison to nearest priors (live arXiv fetches, not timestamps). math/0304494 (Bangert-Katz optimal Loewner-type inequality): proves sharp inequality with abstract equality characterization via Abel-Jacobi Riemannian submersion and Berge-Martinet extremal lattices; no quantitative deficit-vs-distance bound, no constant c. arXiv:0803.0690 (Horowitz-Katz-Katz Loewner with isosystolic defect): Bonnesen-type defect as probabilistic variance of conformal factor w.r.t. flat unit-area metric in same conformal class; measures non-flatness within a fixed conformal class, gives no explicit bound delta>=c*min(d_hyp^2,1) across flat moduli to hex point. arXiv:2502.13715 (Eyll stability for Mobius/Klein): defect bounded by L2 conformal-factor distance in fixed conformal class for different surfaces; different object and distance, leaves flat-tori hyperbolic-moduli stability open. arXiv:2007.03674 (GNS stability): evidences recognized demand for explicit stability constants for sharp inequalities but different inequality/method. No source states or mechanically implies c=1/2 with minimizer switch (|tau|=1 folded to y=1/arc split) and global hyperbolic cap min(.,1) over full SL(2,Z)\H. Elementary Gauss-reduction ingredients do not make the combined global modulus mechanically implied; the comparison 2y-sqrt3>=N(y) with exact threshold equality and cap/tail enclosure is new work.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is self-contained global explicit stability lemma: first quantitative modulus upgrading sharp Loewner rigidity (sys^2/area<=2/sqrt3, equality at hex) to deficit-controls-moduli-distance over the full natural moduli space SL(2,Z)\H with concrete c=1/2 (stronger than topic example 1/10). Object (unit-area flat tori + Loewner deficit + hyperbolic moduli distance) and invariant (explicit c) were motivated before computation as quantitative stability of a recognized sharp inequality, with stated downstream almost-extremal compactness use and template for related systolic stabilities. Value not known or mechanically implied; future researcher can reasonably need the precise fact. This is a proved inequality over a continuum, not database repackaging, determinant-box enumeration, parameter substitution, or tiny unmotivated gain. Certification (integer-exact thresholds + stdlib replay) strengthens but does not create the value. Fallbacks subsumed; no incomplete census claimed. Independently worth retrieving.
